shared_elements: human figure in strict profile, low relief
elaborately patterned hair and beard rendered as rows of curls
bare muscular arm with defined wrist and hand
textured infill conventions (fleece, feathers, hair as repeated pattern units)
figure facing and gesturing/holding toward an object
justification: Both depict profile human figures in shallow relief with the same conventions — curled beard/hair rendered as regimented rows, defined bare forearms, and dense patterned infill for hair, fleece or feathers — and both include stylised plants and multi-petalled rosettes, which together suggests a shared carving idiom. The depicted subjects differ substantially, however: A is a horizontal processional register of ordinary men leading rams past a tree, framed by rosette borders, whereas B is a single large winged, elaborately crowned figure raising a hand toward a stylised palmette-rosette plant, with no procession, animals or border bands.
